claim_scope: Correct the legacy water ledger so that the already-existing interception storage change is observed in the selected water control volume. Do not change hydrology, water-state representation, forcing, process fluxes or state promotion semantics.

physical_owner.promotion: Init: Sic = Sict for the applicable detailed-hydrology route

accounting_observation.period_storage_change_mm: sum((Sict - Sic) * 1000) over the active Bawa balance period
accounting_observation.sign_rationale: Hydro_detailed already subtracts end-minus-begin interception storage in its water balance. The legacy Bawa residual omits that same storage contribution.
accounting_observation.implementation_boundary: read or pass existing Sic/Sict into Outbal_calc or an equivalent reporting-only ledger observer; no physical state write is permitted

legacy_total_profile_example.interpretation: The legacy reporting residual is explained to output precision by the omitted interception storage change plus the much smaller detailed-hydrology residual. The value 0.0601 mm is evidence, not an acceptance tolerance.

natural_b1_activation.full_run_relation: Across all 25 annual total-profile balance periods, legacy BAWADV is reproduced to formatted-output precision by summed Hydro_detailed Badev plus final-minus-initial interception storage.

intended_output_whitelist.difference_condition: Only periods/profiles for which the selected Bawa control volume is active and net interception storage changes over the reporting period are expected to differ.
intended_output_whitelist.allowed_semantic_difference: water ledger storage/residual reporting caused solely by inclusion of existing Sic/Sict storage

must_remain_unchanged.non_water_reporting: all ordinary physical outputs and all non-water balance families

noninterference_evidence.prep01_tcd_specific_probe: The temporary interception ledger probe changed no hydrologic state, flux, forcing, soil-water equation or testcase input.
noninterference_evidence.prep02_class_a_combined_probe: Across eight compatible natural cases, the combined TCD-017/TCD-018 Class-A probe compared 379 outputs with 0 unintended differences; 12 intended differences occurred only in the activated LWKM reporting surfaces. The TCD-018-specific whitelist is the water-only subset of those reporting differences.
noninterference_evidence.massq01_observer: The read-only MassLedger observer compared 379 physical outputs across eight natural cases with 0 physical differences after declared volatile normalization and no scientific numeric tolerance.

explicit_exclusions: No change to interception process physics
No balancing correction for unrelated water residuals
No use of 0.0601 mm or any other observed residual as a tolerance
